intro.heading: A small Belgrade crew that loves the view from above.
intro.story: Camera Motion grew out of a simple wish: that footage from the most important days shouldn't feel like a formality, but like a film. We love filming and the technology behind it — we fly DJI drones, shoot with a gimbal-mounted camera and edit everything in Premiere Pro. Still, to us every shot is a story first, and the frames are simply how we tell it.
intro.crew: We do everything ourselves, from the first conversation to delivery — no subcontractors and no strangers showing up on the day of the shoot. You'll usually find us in and around Belgrade, and we're happy to travel further across Serbia and the region — just let us know.

process.heading: How we work
process.intro: No surprises in the price and no “we'll see on the day”. Everything we'll film, and when you'll get it, is written in the quote.

talk.title: A short chat
talk.description: We hear what matters to you and suggest the package that covers it.

prep.title: Preparation
prep.description: We visit the location, check the flight zones and plan the shots.

shoot.title: The shoot
shoot.description: Quiet and unobtrusive — you're with your guests, we do our part.

delivery.title: Editing and delivery
delivery.description: We show you the first cut, then deliver in 4K along with the footage archive.

equipment.heading: Our gear

drones.title: Drones
drones.description: DJI Mini 3 Pro for calm aerial shots and DJI Avata 2 for FPV fly-throughs.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description: Sony a7 IV and Sony a7 III — full-frame cameras that keep the image clean even when the lights go down.

gimbals.title: Gimbals
gimbals.description: DJI RS 4 and DJI RS 3 for smooth handheld shots, even when we move along with you.

microphones.title: Microphones
microphones.description: Wireless and wired microphones, so the vows, the toasts and every interview come through clearly.

equipment.editing: We edit in Adobe Premiere Pro and Vegas Pro with licensed music — so you can share the film on social media without a second thought.
equipment.regulation: Our drones are flown by a pilot registered with the Civil Aviation Directorate of Serbia, strictly in line with its regulations.

cta.heading: Let's meet before the shoot.
cta.subheading: Coffee or a video call — whatever suits you.
